subject: afi
title: AFI.------SCI.DYM.
description: Second diagram on page 86 (CS-14). The crossing diagrams how affinity-insight structurally meets scientific-dynamism at the western-science-affinity-stance scale the prose names: 'the continuum of western scientific thought is directly based in the affinity stance of western culture - having to do with perception within an existential information focus.' AFI (affinity insight) crossed with SCI.DYM (scientific dynamism). AFI sits at upper-center with the subject-arrow; HI-P (high purpose) upper-left and (R)INT (the reality of intention) at left as the subject-side leftward chain. COS-P (cosmic-particulars) upper-right and APL-DT (applied dictates) at right with POST (postulation) below as partner-side upper outputs. EXP-DY (exposure dynamics) sits centrally. DEC (decision), SCI-DY (scientific dynamism, lowercase variant), BIA (bias), ACC-FT (accumulated functionalism) form the lower chain. Structural argument: when affinity-insight is crossed with scientific-dynamism, the upper diagonal COS-P -> APL-DT -> POST is the western-science capture route - cosmic-particulars route through applied-dictates into postulation, reducing the form's affinity-insight to postulation rather than letting it reach scientific-dynamism through the central EXP-DY hub. The lower chain DEC -> SCI-DY -> BIA -> ACC-FT shows what scientific-dynamism produces when not held in axis-crossing with affinity-insight: decision routes through scientific-dynamism into bias and accumulated-functionalism.
